definitions.penalty: GapfillingPkg base penalty x factor; stock factor = 2 for every candidate (no reaction_scores); compartment-aware factor = 2 - max p of member i's genes for the candidate's base reaction (unscored: 2)
definitions.dfactor_e3_minus_kn: factor(E3) - factor(k/n) = p_kn - p_e3, over candidates whose compartment-aware penalty differs between the arms
